title: Klein bottle and Veronese surface embedded in 4D
purpose: Build the Klein bottle and the real projective plane (Veronese surface) as embedded surfaces of R4, prove non-orientability and Euler characteristics on their meshes, show their 3D shadows cross themselves (Steiner's Roman surface), and write both shadows coloured by the fourth coordinate.

parameters.meaning: Klein bottle grid steps along u (even)
Klein bottle grid steps along v
icosphere subdivisions for the Veronese surface

contract.coordinates: surfaces in x, y, z, w; the shadow drops w (Klein) or the fourth Veronese coordinate, Godot/glTF +Y up

limits: Meshes are flat-shaded with duplicated vertices because a non-orientable surface has no consistent normal field; materials are double-sided. The embedding check measures the smallest distance between mesh vertices more than three edges apart, a sampled test rather than a proof. The colour scale of the dropped coordinate is per surface.
technique_references: Klein bottle embedding in R4 by a half-angle twist
